operations.title: The physical total-energy cusp has an integral width-two defect
operations.body: After Kummer-Legendre sign cancellation, the physical E_T=0 cusp has integral monodromy T=[[1,2],[0,1]] in the standard Gamma(2) basis. T-I has rank one, square zero and Smith invariant 2. Thus invariants are Z and coinvariants are Z plus Z/2. This is integral elliptic coefficient monodromy reflecting q_mod~E_T^2, not new carrier support or yet a physical Cut class.

operations.title: Total-energy Legendre integral-monodromy checker
operations.body: The checker verifies T-I=[[0,2],[0,0]], nilpotent square zero, and Smith invariant 2.
